definitionEn: how something is done or how it happens
examples: a lonely way of life

definitionEn: be dressed in
examples: She was wearing yellow that day

definitionEn: the atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation
examples: they were hoping for good weather
every day we have weather conditions and yesterday was no exception

definitionEn: any period of seven consecutive days
examples: it rained for a week

definitionEn: A greeting given upon someone's arrival.
examples: Welcome to our humble village.

definitionEn: accept gladly
examples: I welcome your proposals

definitionEn: in good health especially after having suffered illness or injury
examples: appears to be entirely well
the wound is nearly well

definitionEn: (often used as a combining form) in a good or proper or satisfactory manner or to a high standard (‘good’ is a nonstandard dialectal variant for ‘well’)
examples: the children behaved well
a task well done

definitionEn: Which, especially which of an open-ended set of possibilities.
examples: What colour are you going to use?
What time is it?

definitionEn: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.
examples: When will they arrive?
Do you know when they arrived?

definitionEn: At (or as soon as) that time that; at the (or any and every) time that; if.
examples: Pavlov's dogs salivate when they hear a bell.
When he speaks to her, he is always polite.

definitionEn: In, at or to what place.
examples: Where are you?
He asked where I grew up.

definitionEn: What, of those mentioned or implied.
examples: Which song shall we play?
They couldn't decide which song to play.

definitionEn: What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).
examples: Which is which?
By now, you must surely know which is which.

definitionEn: being of the achromatic color of maximum lightness; having little or no hue owing to reflection of almost all incident light
examples: as white as fresh snow
a bride's white dress

definitionEn: Of whom, belonging to whom; which person's or people's.
examples: Whose (wallet) is this?

definitionEn: That or those of whom or belonging to whom.
examples: Several people have lost their suitcases. Whose have you found?
He asked whose the umbrella was.

definitionEn: For what cause, reason, or purpose.
examples: Why is the sky blue?
Why did you do that?

definitionEn: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.
examples: Do not forget, will you?
I will go with Ted on this one.

definitionEn: be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
examples: Win the game

definitionEn: air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure
examples: trees bent under the fierce winds
when there is no wind, row

definitionEn: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.
examples: She opened the window to let some air in.

definitionEn: a specific feeling of desire
examples: he got his wish
he was above all wishing and desire

definitionEn: Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive.
examples: They served a wonderful six-course meal.
What appears to be wonderful may turn out to be anything but.

definitionEn: a unit of language that native speakers can identify
examples: words are the blocks from which sentences are made
he hardly said ten words all morning

definitionEn: activity directed toward making or doing something
examples: she checked several points needing further work

definitionEn: exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity; work
examples: I will work hard to improve my grades
she worked hard for better living conditions for the poor

definitionEn: a person who works at a specific occupation
examples: he is a good worker

definitionEn: something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness
examples: it's a major worry

definitionEn: not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth
examples: the report in the paper is wrong
your information is wrong

definitionEn: a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days
examples: she is 4 years old
in the year 1920

definitionEn: on the day preceding today
examples: yesterday the weather was beautiful

definitionEn: up to the present time
examples: I have yet to see the results
details are yet to be worked out

definitionEn: The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
examples: Both of you should get ready now.
I'll look up you and your sister.

definitionEn: (used of living things especially persons) in an early period of life or development or growth
examples: young people

definitionEn: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (singular; one owner).
examples: Let’s meet tomorrow at your convenience.
Is this your cat?

definitionEn: That or those belonging to you; the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun.
examples: If this edit is mine, the other must be yours.
Their encyclopedia is good, but yours is even better.

definitionEn: Your own self (singular).
examples: Be careful with that fire or you'll burn yourself.
After a good night's sleep you'll feel like yourself again.

definitionEn: A park where live animals are exhibited.
examples: The London Zoo was built in 1828.
